output.narrative:
The CTR experienced a downward movement, driven primarily by decreases in the rewarded ad format (lift 5.61, explanatory power 0.488) and social category (lift 2.61, explanatory power 0.25). 

Within rewarded ads, further drill-down points to CPG vertical (lift 4.32, explanatory power 0.398). Conversely, the banner ad format (lift -0.39, explanatory_power -0.135) and publisher_tier=tier_2 segment (lift -0.16, explanatory_power -0.072) were checked and ruled out as they did not disproportionately explain the drop.
